For a 50-person Indian company, Zoho is somewhat different from a traditional travel-management company: it combines travel booking/workflows with expense management.

Provider	Current price	Key exclusions/limits	Best suited for
Zoho Corporation / Zoho Expense	₹79/user/month Standard; ₹149 Premium, billed annually. 50 users ≈ ₹47,400–₹89,400/year. 
Zoho
	Subscription covers software; actual flights/hotels and potentially third-party travel services are extra. Some advanced integrations/features are add-ons. 
Zoho
	Companies wanting travel + expense automation in one system.
Cleartrip for Business	₹0 setup/subscription fee publicly advertised; booking costs/fare prices apply. 
Cleartrip
	Not a fixed-price managed-service package; travel purchases remain variable.	Cost-conscious teams wanting self-booking + corporate fares.
FCM Travel	Custom quotation; no public India-wide subscription price.	Programme/service fees and travel costs depend on contract.	Companies needing dedicated TMC support, negotiated inventory and 24/7 assistance. 
FCM Travel
+1

Thomas Cook India Corporate Travel	Custom quotation.	Bespoke servicing means costs depend on scope, travel volume and services selected.	Firms wanting human-managed travel plus technology, including visa, forex, rail, air and hotels. 
Thomas Cook

Key distinction: Zoho's published price is a software licence, not an all-in travel budget; the three TMC options generally require a negotiated commercial quote.

Prada Paradoxe EDP — ₹12,420: Elegant, modern and feminine. A good choice if you want something polished and unmistakably designer without being too loud. 
Perfume24x7.com

Carolina Herrera Good Girl EDP — ₹10,600: More sensual and evening-oriented, with a distinctive bottle that makes it feel especially gift-like. 
Perfume24x7.com

Dior Sauvage EDT — ₹13,000: Masculine, fresh and versatile. Best suited if the recipient prefers clean, confident fragrances that work for both everyday and date nights.

Gift angle: For an anniversary, Prada/Good Girl feels more romantic; Sauvage is the stronger choice for a male recipient. Prices can vary by retailer and size.
